name: Grok 4.7
note_long: The most ambitious illustrations: sunsets, lighting, spray and texture. The hardware is hit and miss: run 3 has a pod and propeller under water, run 2 loses the mast entirely.

note.en: Sunsets, spray, light. The hardware is hit and miss.
note.ru: Закаты, брызги, свет. Железо — как повезёт.
